description: Court records from two official open sources in one answer: US federal dockets matching a term (CourtListener) and Indian Supreme Court judgment metadata for a year (AWS Open Data). Each item names its source. Not a full court index of any country. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_global_tender_funding_watch when you need latest public tender and contract items from three official; gov_court_records_ecourt_india when you need Indian High Court judgments and final orders. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Term for US dockets, 2 to 100 characters

year.description: Indian Supreme Court judgment year, 1950 to 2025
